intro.h2: Design and construction under one Sarasota roof
paragraphs: S&W Kitchens offers kitchen and bath remodeling in Sarasota, FL from a design showroom on 5th Street in the Rosemary Design District. The company has worked in Florida since 1977 and now runs seven showrooms, from Winter Park to Tampa. In Sarasota, the design and construction teams share one building, so the people who draw your plan also build it.

The promise is predictability. Each project is mapped in a detailed Project Book, and the company reports that 96% of its projects finish on budget and on schedule. Cabinets are made in the USA, everyone who works in your home is background-checked, and 0% financing is available through trusted local lenders.

services.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Sarasota, FL, plus the spaces around them

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Choose a refresh that keeps your layout, a full remodel that changes function and flow, or a luxury remodel. Designers show realistic renderings before construction, and your project manager coordinates S&W's in-house installers from demolition to the final tile.

image.alt: Clearwater kitchen remodel with warm wood shaker cabinets, a quartz island with seating and a wood-wrapped ceiling beam

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: From a tired hall bath to a primary suite that moves plumbing and expands the footprint. Recent work near Sarasota includes primary bath updates in Venice and Bradenton. Designers plan storage, lighting and tile, and the same team handles installation.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with natural wood vanity, dark green tile accent wall, freestanding tub and glass shower

items.name: Aging in Place
items.blurb: Designers with the Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS) designation plan curbless showers, wider clearances and non-slip floors that still look good, so a forever home stays safe for decades. One Lock Street project paired a zero-entry shower with the tub.

image.alt: Aging-in-place bathroom with a zero-entry shower behind a black grid glass panel and a long vanity with a seated makeup area

items.name: Outdoor Kitchens
items.blurb: Covered outdoor kitchens built for Florida entertaining, with built-in grills, vent hoods, stone or tile backsplashes and bar seating. The Sarasota showroom page features one of these projects as an outdoor entertainer's space. S&W keeps a separate outdoor kitchen portfolio you can browse before you visit.

image.alt: Covered outdoor kitchen with built-in grill, blue stone backsplash, black vent hood and bar stools under a wood ceiling

items.name: Custom Cabinets and Closets
items.blurb: USA-made cabinetry in warm white oak, walnut or clean contemporary finishes, plus luxury lines from Poggenpohl and Bentwood. Closet designers plan wardrobes, islands and lighting around what you own, and laundry rooms and home bars are on the list too.

image.alt: Custom walk-in closet in Orlando with frosted glass-front wardrobes, a stone-topped island and a crystal chandelier

items.title: 96% on budget and on schedule
items.text: A detailed Project Book and precise estimating set a number you can plan around. The company reports that 96% of its projects finish on budget and on schedule.

items.title: A showroom you can walk through
items.text: The Rosemary District showroom sets cabinets, counters and tile up the way they would sit in your kitchen, and a professional designer is always available to answer questions.

items.title: Licensed and certified
items.text: S&W is a licensed, state-certified and insured contractor (CBC1262059), a member of the NKBA and the Florida Home Builders Association, and holds the CAPS designation.

items.title: Financing options
items.text: S&W partners with GreenSky and local lenders for deferred-interest promotions, 0% financing and monthly plans. Some clients finance several projects at once to limit disruption.

about.h2: The people behind the Sarasota design center
about.text: S&W Kitchens is family owned and operated and has served Florida homeowners since 1977. Joe Steenbeke Jr. leads the company as President and CEO. In Sarasota, Regional Manager Larissa Hicks heads a design center where designers, project managers and construction staff work side by side. The company has grown to seven showrooms and 33 national awards, yet it still runs each remodel as a team job: everyone who touches your home knows the plan, from first sketch to final walkthrough.

image.alt: S&W Kitchens Sarasota showroom on 5th Street in the Rosemary Design District, with palm trees out front

process.h2: From showroom visit to finished room

steps.title: Request your free estimate
steps.text: Send the short form or call, and a designer replies within 1 to 2 business days to set up your complimentary design consultation.

steps.title: Design consultation
steps.text: Your designer visits your home to measure the space, talk through goals and learn how you live, then starts your free estimate and design plan.

steps.title: Design, project and budget review
steps.text: You see realistic renderings of the layout, finishes and fixtures, and review the Project Book and budget before construction begins.

steps.title: Professional installation
steps.text: A dedicated S&W project manager coordinates the in-house installers from demolition to the final tile, with the whole team briefed on your plan.

service_area.h2: Sarasota, Manatee and the barrier islands
service_area.text: The Sarasota showroom serves the metro area and communities through Southwest Florida, from Anna Maria and Holmes Beach down to Venice and North Port. Portfolio work spans coastal kitchens in West of Trail neighborhoods and bath updates in Venice and Bradenton. Six more S&W showrooms cover Tampa Bay, Orlando and the Space Coast, and the zip code on your estimate form routes you to the nearest designer.

faq.h2: What Sarasota clients ask before a remodel

items.q: When is the Sarasota showroom open?
items.a: The showroom at 1421 5th St is open Monday to Friday, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm, and Saturday, 10:00 am to 2:00 pm. It is closed Sunday. A designer is always on hand, but calling (941) 274-3552 ahead is the surest way to get a full sit-down about your project.

items.q: What does the free estimate include?
items.a: After you send the form, a designer reaches out within 1 to 2 business days. At your complimentary design consultation they measure your space, talk through your goals and style, and begin your free estimate and design plan. Your zip code helps route you to the closest showroom.

items.q: Can I finance a kitchen or bath remodel?
items.a: Yes. S&W has partnered with GreenSky to offer deferred-interest promotional plans and affordable monthly payments, and it works with trusted local lenders on 0% financing. Some clients use financing to finish several projects at once, which limits the disruption in the home.

items.q: Do you design bathrooms for aging in place?
items.a: Yes. S&W holds the Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS) designation. Designers plan curbless showers, wider clearances and non-slip flooring that do not give up style, so a forever home stays safe and comfortable. The Lock Street project, for example, combined a zero-entry shower with a tub.

S&W offers a wide selection of cabinets made in the USA, from warm white oak and walnut to contemporary finishes. For homeowners who want the finest materials, the company also works with the luxury brands Poggenpohl and Bentwood. You can compare styles and colors in the Sarasota design center.

final_cta.h2: See your new kitchen before it is built
final_cta.text: Call the Sarasota showroom at (941) 274-3552 or request a free estimate, and a designer will reply within 1 to 2 business days.
